1d.text: After a day, an admin can decide on their own if not enough people have voted.

7d.text: After a week, an admin can decide on their own if not enough people have voted. This keeps a decision from being stuck forever when people don't respond.

30d.text: After a month, an admin can decide on their own. Decisions can sit open for a long time.

open-ended.text: An admin can never force a decision. If not enough people vote, it stays open indefinitely — nothing is decided until the circle decides it.

off.text: No AI assistance in this circle — nothing is sent to any model.

local.text: AI runs on a member's own machine (Ollama). Messages stay on-device; nothing goes to the cloud.

cloud.text: AI runs on an independent cloud model. Your messages are sent to that provider when you ask it something.

yes.text: Anyone can add an AI agent as a participant. Agents can read whatever the circle shares.

admin-approval.text: AI agents may join only after an admin approves — a checkpoint before any agent sees circle content.

no.text: No AI agents may join. Only people take part in this circle.

pairwise.text: Real names are revealed one-to-one. Each member chooses who gets to see their identity.

open.text: Every member can see each other's real names. There is no per-person hiding.

none.text: Nothing is stored to a pod. Data lives only on members' devices and is lost if they clear it.

shared.text: One shared pod holds the circle's data — every member reads and writes the same store.

personal.text: Each member keeps their own pod and the circle links to them by reference. You keep control of your own copy.

hybrid.text: A shared pod plus personal pods: common items are shared, private items stay with each member.

closed.text: Items can't be shared outside this circle. Sharing out is turned off.

copy.text: Sharing out sends a separate, freshly sealed copy to the recipient. They get their own copy — later edits in the circle don't reach it, and you can't take it back.

trusted.text: The live item itself is shared in place: the recipient is given a key to open the circle's own copy, no duplicate is made. Any member can share an item this way.

registered.text: Same live, in-place sharing as 'Live share (members)', but only an admin may add a recipient. Members can't share items out on their own.

canonical.text: The item stays in place in this circle — no copy is made. The recipient gets a revocable key to open it. Un-sharing rotates the key so they lose access.
